review.note: Retracted in M22: the Madeiran regional election of 9 October 1988, won again by the Social Democrats under Alberto João Jardim. The atlas keeps the first exercise of an institution and the ballot at which it became a cycle, and retracts the routine repetitions after them; the fourth Madeiran regional election is one. The only link available is the constitutional one the earlier records already carry. Revisit if a consequence is written.
